description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. The class filters log messages to only pass through the message content, omitting metadata such as tag and priority, and is used for simplified log output, especially on-screen logs.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that implements LogNode, passing only message content downstream.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters logs to only pass the message content to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode for the chain.
